title: Validate IP Address
description:
Return `"IPv4"` when `queryIP` is a valid IPv4 address, `"IPv6"` when it is a valid IPv6 address, and `"Neither"` otherwise. IPv4 has exactly four decimal fields from 0 to 255 with no leading zero unless the field is `"0"`. IPv6 has exactly eight hexadecimal fields, each 1 to 4 characters long; leading zeros are allowed. IPv6 fields may use digits and `a`–`f` in either case. Compressed IPv6 notation is invalid.

## Examples

```text
Input: queryIP = "172.16.254.1"
Output: "IPv4"
```

```text
Input: queryIP = "2001:0db8:85a3:0:0:8A2E:0370:7334"
Output: "IPv6"
```

```text
Input: queryIP = "256.256.256.256"
Output: "Neither"
```

## Constraints

- `queryIP` contains only English letters, digits, `.` and `:`
